Run Substitution Model Selection (ModelFinder) in IQ-TREE

test_sub_model.Rd

Copies a FASTA alignment into a dedicated run subdirectory, generates a shell script, and executes IQ-TREE with -m MF to test substitution models.

Usage

test_sub_model(
  fasta_path,
  run_name,
  output_folder,
  iqtree_exe =
    "/Users/hu_zhehao/Desktop/utils/biology-tools/iqtree-2.3.6-macOS-arm/bin/iqtree2"
)

Arguments

fasta_path

Character. Path to the input FASTA alignment file.

run_name

Character. Run label used to create the subdirectory and output prefix.

output_folder

Character. Base parent folder where run_name will be created.

iqtree_exe

Character. Path to the IQ-TREE executable.

Value

Character path to the created run output directory (file.path(output_folder, run_name)).

See also

Other alignment: check_polish(), codon_summary(), concatenate_alignment(), gblocks(), mafft(), polish_alignment(), split_concat_alignment(), summarize_alignment(), trim_empty_columns()
